tagline: Leveraging computational biology and AI to develop innovative agricultural and health solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Evogene is a computational biotechnology company centered on innovation through R&D, with a business model entirely based on developing high-potential products via proprietary technology platforms. R&D is therefore the primary driver of long-term value creation.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Exact headcount is not disclosed in the 10-K/20-F reviewed. The company is structured around proprietary technology platforms.
kpis.signal: Headcount concentrated on scientific and technology teams.

kpis.name: Available Cash
kpis.explanation: Amount of cash and cash equivalents held.
kpis.description: The company received a Nasdaq notification on April 2, 2026 regarding non-compliance with the minimum stock price of $1.00 per share, indicating significant cash constraints.
kpis.signal: Critical cash position flagged via Nasdaq minimum price non-compliance notice.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue includes approximately $2.168 million in Casterra orders delivered to ENI in Q1 2025 for sale of proprietary castor seed varieties, as well as payments received from licensing agreements (e.g., $5 million Corteva termination fee).
kpis.signal: Revenue primarily derived from one-off collaborations and licensing transactions.

kpis.name: Annual Net Loss
kpis.description: The company is not profitable. Losses reflect the long-term development model and R&D investments without significant commercial revenue.
kpis.signal: Systemic loss structure typical of an advanced-stage R&D biotech company.

kpis.name: ENI Casterra Contract
kpis.explanation: Value of castor seed orders delivered to ENI for large-scale biological production.
kpis.description: On June 21, 2023, Casterra (Evogene subsidiary) signed a master agreement with ENI to sell proprietary castor seed varieties. In Q1 2025, approximately $2.168 million in orders (prior order backlog) were delivered. No new orders received since the 2025 report.
kpis.signal: First significant commercialization of a Casterra proprietary variety, validating agricultural technology.

kpis.name: Corteva License Agreement
kpis.explanation: Initial payment received without refund following termination of license agreement with Corteva for bio-fungicides.
kpis.description: On July 14, 2023, Lavie Bio (Evogene subsidiary) signed an exclusive perpetual license agreement with Corteva to develop and commercialize bio-fungicide candidates. In November 2024, Corteva notified termination. Lavie Bio retained the $5 million initial payment and regained all technology rights.
kpis.signal: Recovery of technology rights following license termination, increasing potential for internal value realization.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 0.02 billion € in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.0 billion € in latest year

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue includes approximately $2.168 million in Casterra orders delivered to ENI in Q1 2025 and licensing payments.
kpis.signal: Revenue derived from one-off collaborations and licensing transactions.

kpis.name: Critical Cash Position
kpis.explanation: Cash position status and risks related to listing rule compliance.
kpis.description: On April 2, 2026, Evogene received Nasdaq notification of non-compliance with the minimum stock price of $1.00 per share (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)), revealing significant deterioration in financial position and increasing delisting risk.
kpis.signal: Nasdaq minimum price non-compliance notice indicating structural cash constraints.

risks.title: Dependence on key collaborators for commercialization
risks.score_rationale: Risk is at the top of the risk factors summary, with strong language (substantially dependent), stable trend, and critical because linked to revenue generation through third parties.

risks.title: Operational concentration risk following strategic refocus
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the summary, with alert language (increases risk), stable trend, and tied to a recent strategy that amplifies the impact of potential failures.

risks.title: Inadequate intellectual property protection
risks.score_rationale: Risk repeated multiple times, with strong language (our success depends), stable trend, and central because tied to the company's core technology.

risks.title: Dependence on ChemPass AI engine
risks.score_rationale: Key mention in the summary (if we fail to maintain ChemPass), urgent language, stable trend, and maximum weight because tied to the central R&D platform.

risks.title: Production and scale-up difficulties
risks.score_rationale: Present in the summary with concerned language (could hinder), stable trend, and linked to the critical phase of commercial scale-up.

risks.title: Competition from better-capitalized companies
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned, strong comparative language (substantially greater resources), stable trend, and critical because structural in agricultural and health sectors.

risks.title: Government regulation and approvals
risks.score_rationale: Cited in the summary with direct operational impact (could halt our operations), stable trend, and high weight in agricultural and health sectors.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and cloud dependence
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in risks and in a dedicated item (16K), reinforcing language (evolving threats), stable trend, and critical for protection of sensitive data.

ai_positioning.summary: Evogene integrates artificial intelligence and computational biology as the foundation of its innovation model, particularly for developing agricultural products and microbiological solutions. AI is at the heart of its proprietary technology platforms for agriculture and health.
evidence: Use of computational platforms for plant variety design (Casterra) and biological agents (Lavie Bio)
Approach based on massive data analysis to identify and optimize agricultural solutions
Development of solutions via predictive modeling and artificial intelligence integrated into R&D processes
